content: {"action":"escalate","reasoning":"CO-97 is a bundling denial, not an authorization or medical-necessity denial, so retro authorization, peer-to-peer review, and a necessity appeal do not properly address it. Resubmission is also inappropriate without first identifying the paid service and determining whether a coding correction or modifier is supported. A billing specialist must review the related adjudication and bundling edit before the claim can be progressed correctly."}
